free_tier.stated: The FAQ states that a new user gets 20 GB of long-term storage on registration, with uploads of up to 5 GB per file for a free user. The quota page that shows the actual allocation per account is behind a sign-in
free_tier.notes: A news report of 2026-09-25 states that new users registered after 9月24日14:30 get 专业空间50GB加标准空间50GB until real-name verification, then 标准空间 rises to 2TB

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB per file for a free user upload (members 30 GB per file in the client). The limit applies only to newly uploaded files; instant upload, copy and save are not affected

retention.stated: Share links expire; live keys returned 5104 分享已过期. Account retention is not published

egress.terms: Upload and download speed is not limited for any user. Accounts registered before 2026-11-04 get 10 GB of self-use download traffic per month (the app and PC client meter it at half the file size); accounts registered from 2026-11-04 get no monthly traffic by default and can earn it by watching ads in the app. The traffic is for downloads, playback and preview in the user's own cloud only, not on a share page
egress.free_allowance: 10 GB per month for accounts registered before 2026-11-04; none by default for accounts registered from 2026-11-04

tooling: an official Open Platform at open-api.123pan.com with client id and key and a refresh-token flow; the OpenList '123 Open' driver; WebDAV at webdav.123pan.cn/webdav with app passwords, up to ten per account; the Python client ChenyangGao/p123client
chaining: The gate is a +86 number and the free tier is one per identity, so there is no multiplication from outside China. The one interesting shape is the deduplicated 标准空间: saving an already-present blob costs no quota, so a shared corpus can be mirrored into many accounts at no storage cost

limits.value: 5 GB per file for a free user upload; the limit applies only to newly uploaded files
10 GB per month of self-use download traffic for accounts registered before 2026-11-04, metered at half the file size in the app and PC client
share-link downloads need no registration or login; the FAQ states that a non-member can buy membership or pay per download

identity_cost.detail: registration takes a mobile number, a login password and an SMS code; WeChat QR login is also offered, and first binding it needs an SMS verification

reliability_note: A share download can be funded by the sharer: the homepage states a mode where the sharer bears the download traffic by enabling a traffic pack in the share settings, so the receiver downloads without login at no charge

binding_note: The capacity is real and large, so the quota is not what stops a plan. 10 GB of extraction traffic a month is 0.03% of the daily target, and the identity gate means the tier cannot even be bought from outside China.
